1	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
2	import { getStripe } from './client'
3	import { idempotencyKeyFor, withIdempotencyKey } from './idempotency'
4	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
5	import {
6	  RPC,
7	  cents,
8	  type CentsAmount,
9	  type Currency,
10	  type StripeInvoiceRecordArgs,
11	} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
12	
13	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
14	// Local structural interface — matches the Stripe Invoice API response shape.
15	// The Stripe SDK types vary by moduleResolution; this structural type avoids that.
16	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
17	
18	interface StripeInvoiceResponse {
19	  id: string
20	  status: string | null
21	  total: number | null
22	  subtotal: number | null
23	  tax: number | null
24	  amount_paid: number | null
25	  amount_due: number | null
26	  payment_intent: string | { id: string; status: string; client_secret: string | null } | null
27	  automatic_tax?: { status?: string | null } | null
28	}
29	
30	type PaymentIntentStatus =
31	  | 'requires_payment_method'
32	  | 'requires_confirmation'
33	  | 'requires_action'
34	  | 'processing'
35	  | 'requires_capture'
36	  | 'canceled'
37	  | 'succeeded'
38	
39	export interface CreateSessionInvoiceArgs {
40	  studioId: string
41	  bookingId: string
42	  projectId: string
43	  sessionId: string
44	  artistId: string
45	  clientId: string
46	  customerId: string
47	  paymentMethodId: string
48	  currency: Currency
49	  baseAmountCents: CentsAmount
50	  tipAmountCents: CentsAmount
51	  depositDrawdownCents: CentsAmount
52	  applicationFeeCents: CentsAmount
53	  destinationAccount: string
54	}
55	
56	export interface CreateSessionInvoiceResult {
57	  invoiceId: string
58	  paymentIntentId: string | null
59	  paymentIntentClientSecret: string | null
60	  paymentIntentStatus: PaymentIntentStatus | null
61	  taxAmountCents: CentsAmount
62	  totalCents: CentsAmount
63	}
64	
65	export async function createSessionInvoice(
66	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
67	  args: CreateSessionInvoiceArgs,
68	): Promise<CreateSessionInvoiceResult> {
69	  const stripe = getStripe()
70	  const idemKey = idempotencyKeyFor('invoice.create', {
71	    booking_id: args.bookingId,
72	    session_id: args.sessionId,
73	  })
74	
75	  const invoice = await withIdempotencyKey(idemKey, (key) =>
76	    stripe.invoices.create(
77	      {
78	        customer: args.customerId,
79	        currency: args.currency,
80	        collection_method: 'charge_automatically',
81	        default_payment_method: args.paymentMethodId,
82	        application_fee_amount: args.applicationFeeCents,
83	        transfer_data: { destination: args.destinationAccount },
84	        on_behalf_of: args.destinationAccount,
85	        automatic_tax: { enabled: true },
86	        metadata: {
87	          inkos_idempotency_key: key,
88	          inkos_studio_id: args.studioId,
89	          inkos_booking_id: args.bookingId,
90	          inkos_project_id: args.projectId,
91	          inkos_session_id: args.sessionId,
92	          inkos_artist_id: args.artistId,
93	          inkos_client_id: args.clientId,
94	          inkos_deposit_drawdown_cents: String(args.depositDrawdownCents),
95	        },
96	      },
97	      { idempotencyKey: key },
98	    ),
99	  )
100	
101	  await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
102	    {
103	      customer: args.customerId,
104	      invoice: invoice.id,
105	      currency: args.currency,
106	      amount: args.baseAmountCents,
107	      description: 'Tattoo session base',
108	      metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'base' },
109	    },
110	    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:base` },
111	  )
112	
113	  if (args.tipAmountCents > 0) {
114	    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
115	      {
116	        customer: args.customerId,
117	        invoice: invoice.id,
118	        currency: args.currency,
119	        amount: args.tipAmountCents,
120	        description: 'Tip',
121	        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'tip' },
122	      },
123	      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:tip` },
124	    )
125	  }
126	
127	  if (args.depositDrawdownCents > 0) {
128	    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
129	      {
130	        customer: args.customerId,
131	        invoice: invoice.id,
132	        currency: args.currency,
133	        amount: -args.depositDrawdownCents,
134	        description: 'Deposit applied',
135	        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'deposit_drawdown' },
136	      },
137	      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:drawdown` },
138	    )
139	  }
140	
141	  await stripe.invoices.finalizeInvoice(
142	    invoice.id,
143	    { auto_advance: true },
144	    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:finalize` },
145	  )
146	
147	  let paidRaw: unknown
148	  try {
149	    paidRaw = await stripe.invoices.pay(
150	      invoice.id,
151	      { payment_method: args.paymentMethodId, off_session: true },
152	      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:pay` },
153	    )
154	  } catch (err) {
155	    logger.error({ invoice_id: invoice.id, err }, 'S19 invoice pay failed')
156	    throw err
157	  }
158	
159	  const paid = paidRaw as StripeInvoiceResponse
160	
161	  const recordArgs: StripeInvoiceRecordArgs = {
162	    studioId: args.studioId,
163	    invoiceId: paid.id,
164	    customerId: args.customerId,
165	    status: paid.status as 'paid' | 'open' | 'draft' | 'uncollectible' | 'void',
166	    currency: args.currency,
167	    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
168	    subtotalCents: cents(paid.subtotal ?? 0),
169	    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
170	    amountPaidCents: cents(paid.amount_paid ?? 0),
171	    amountDueCents: cents(paid.amount_due ?? 0),
172	    bookingId: args.bookingId,
173	    projectId: args.projectId,
174	    sessionId: args.sessionId,
175	    clientId: args.clientId,
176	    automaticTaxStatus:
177	      (paid.automatic_tax?.status ?? null) as
178	        | 'requires_location_inputs'
179	        | 'failed'
180	        | 'complete'
181	        | null,
182	    idempotencyKey: idemKey,
183	  }
184	
185	  const { error: recordErr } = await supabase.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_INVOICE_RECORD, {
186	    p_studio_id: recordArgs.studioId,
187	    p_invoice_id: recordArgs.invoiceId,
188	    p_customer_id: recordArgs.customerId,
189	    p_status: recordArgs.status,
190	    p_currency: recordArgs.currency,
191	    p_total_cents: recordArgs.totalCents,
192	    p_subtotal_cents: recordArgs.subtotalCents,
193	    p_tax_amount_cents: recordArgs.taxAmountCents,
194	    p_amount_paid_cents: recordArgs.amountPaidCents,
195	    p_amount_due_cents: recordArgs.amountDueCents,
196	    p_booking_id: recordArgs.bookingId,
197	    p_project_id: recordArgs.projectId,
198	    p_session_id: recordArgs.sessionId,
199	    p_client_id: recordArgs.clientId,
200	    p_automatic_tax_status: recordArgs.automaticTaxStatus,
201	    p_idempotency_key: recordArgs.idempotencyKey,
202	  })
203	
204	  if (recordErr) {
205	    logger.error(
206	      { invoice_id: paid.id, err: recordErr },
207	      'CRITICAL: stripe_invoice_record failed after invoice paid — rethrowing for retry',
208	    )
209	    throw recordErr
210	  }
211	
212	  const pi = paid.payment_intent
213	  const piId = typeof pi === 'string' ? pi : pi?.id ?? null
214	  const piStatus: PaymentIntentStatus | null =
215	    typeof pi === 'object' && pi !== null
216	      ? (pi.status as PaymentIntentStatus)
217	      : null
218	
219	  return {
220	    invoiceId: paid.id,
221	    paymentIntentId: piId,
222	    paymentIntentClientSecret: null,
223	    paymentIntentStatus: piStatus,
224	    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
225	    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
226	  }
227	}
228
